notes: The SVR-5200S is Savant's "Pro Host" whole-home automation/control server (built on Mac mini-class hardware), not an AV receiver despite the model naming convention. Authoritative source: Savant's own Pro Host Quick Reference Guide (doc 009-2007-01, rev 210310), which shows a labeled rear-panel diagram with lettered callouts A-F. Only 5 items are officially documented/lettered: Power LED (front panel), Power Button, Power Input (100-240V AC 50/60Hz, figure-8/IEC-C7-8-style inlet), Ethernet (10/100/1000 Base-T), Cooling Vent, and Audio Out (3.5mm analog 2-channel). The rear-panel diagram also depicts an HDMI port, two USB-C ports bearing a Thunderbolt (lightning-bolt) icon, and two USB-A ports, but Savant's own note states: "Connections not identified in the diagram above are not functional within a Savant Configuration/Installation" — i.e. these physical ports exist on the shared hardware platform but are not supported/enabled for use in a Savant install. No version/speed is stated for USB or Thunderbolt so no grade was set; HDMI version is also unstated. Rack space is listed as 1U in the spec sheet though the unit is typically deployed on a shelf/rack tray (RCK-3000) rather than a standard rack-ear chassis. Power connector was mapped to iec-c7 (closest match to the depicted figure-8/two-hole inlet icon); exact IEC sub-type (C7 vs C8) could not be confirmed from the icon alone.
